title: Viewport preview sky completely washes out transparent scene objects and gizmos
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in `4.5.1.stable`, `4.4.1.stable`
Not reproducible in `4.3.stable`

### System information

Godot v4.5.1.stable - Windows 11 (build 26100) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Mobile) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 SUPER (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.7652) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-10700F CPU @ 2.90GHz (16 threads) - 15.92 GiB memory

### Issue description

When the viewport preview environment is bright (e.g. white sky and white ground, with energy 1.0), it will render _in front_ of any transparent objects or gizmos in the viewport, completely obscuring them. This is _not due to Glow_.

This is problematic because it makes it difficult to see or select objects when the user simply wants a white background.

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/75f06ffd-f2e9-4e80-aab7-a9a166cea7b4)

Details:
- Does not happen on Compatibility renderer
- Happens with or without Glow
- Does not affect pieces of the transform gizmo that are highlighted by the cursor, indicating perhaps it has to do with render priority

### Steps to reproduce

- Open attached project / scene
- Turn on the 3D viewport preview environment
- Turn off glow, and make sky and ground completely white, and energy 1.0
- Select the sphere in the scene, and rotate the camera
- Notice the white from the horizon completely obscures the sphere and the transform gizmo.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[bug-report-2.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/23698845/bug-report-2.zip)
